title: 1. Measure actuator headroom downstream of the saturated spin drive
hypothesis: Final joint-action clipping removes substantial spin-command authority even when the upstream spin-drive nonlinearity is bypassed.

prediction.against: R-046 parent: identical replay interventions before final action clipping
prediction.rationale: Measure the mean absolute per-axis action difference induced by drive overrides d-0.10 versus d+0.10, before and after final clipping. A reduction of 0.02 normalized action units would identify a second feedback bottleneck. D-048 established upstream saturation but did not isolate downstream authority; this is the one diagnostic measurement needed before attempting a clipping-aware repair.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --advisor-protocol actuator_authority --protocol-seeds 4520"'
code_changes: scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: add the declared advisor-protocol CLI, record frozen-parent in-play observations and intermediate action components, and replay drive overrides without executing counterfactual actions
config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml: add actuator_authority settings, frozen parent config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent, and episode-clustered paired intervals
config/manifests/pen_spin_authority_screen_s4520.yaml: freeze 32 fresh diagnostic cases; never use these cases for promotion

falsified_by: The paired interval upper bound for the clipping-induced reduction is below 0.02; an interval crossing the threshold is inconclusive.

advisor.reasoning: This isolates downstream clipping, which D-048's upstream saturation measurements did not settle, for 32 episodes and zero LLM calls using scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py and config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Its limitation is that replay measures local action authority, not whether executing different commands improves control. Retain the prediction of action_variation_by_axis decreasing by at least 0.02 after clipping versus identical pre-clipping R-046 drive-override replay. Falsified_by: the paired reduction interval upper bound is below 0.02; an interval crossing 0.02 is inconclusive.

implementer.reasoning: Reject. The quantity R-059 wants is already bounded by numbers D-048 recorded, and the exact value needs no simulator episode. (1) Executed-action saturation (fraction of executed components with |a| >= 0.99) over every recorded in-play fresh step is 5.4-7.6% for the parent and both winners in all eight blocks (research_result.json, controllers.*.fresh.action_saturated_fraction_per_block): on an average step 1-1.5 of 20 joint commands are clipped at all. (2) The drive override d-0.10 vs d+0.10 moves the pre-clip command by stroke_amp (0.56 for the parent) x 0.20 x the tangent projection x the joint map coefficients (0.35-1.0), i.e. about 0.03-0.10 normalised units on the finger joints and zero on the others; clipping can remove that difference only on the clipped components, so the clipping-induced reduction is at most about 8% of 0.03-0.10, below 0.01 and below the 0.02 threshold on the arithmetic alone. (3) Even if one wanted the exact per-axis number, it is a CPU computation: R-058 recorded the observations of every in-play step of the parent and both winners on 320 promotion and 320 fresh cases (block_s*/*_promotion.npz, *_fresh.npz), and the policy's pre-clip mean under a drive override is a forward pass on those observations with the drive term substituted; a replay in Isaac adds nothing because the override is never executed (the protocol says so itself). A 32-episode protocol, a new CLI and a new manifest for a number that is bounded below its own threshold and computable offline is not a research idea under this direction; if the advisor wants the exact figure I will compute it from the R-058 traces and attach it to the next result file at zero cost.

advisor.reasoning: I accept the implementer's decisive argument: the requested non-executed interventions can be computed from saved R-058 observations, so 32 new simulator episodes and zero LLM calls are unnecessary. The weaker saturation-based bound is not conclusive because overrides can newly clip components. The diagnostic prediction remains action_variation_by_axis decreasing by at least 0.02 after clipping versus identical pre-clipping R-046 override replay; falsified_by: the paired reduction interval upper bound is below 0.02, with a threshold-crossing interval inconclusive. Reconsider simulator spending only if necessary replay inputs are missing and the unresolved measurement would determine an otherwise eligible repair.

implementer.reasoning: Agree: rejected.
